title: The COVID-19 Pandemic on the Turkish Twittersphere
reasoning: While the paper tracks religion as one of its six key thematic pillars in Turkish public discourse, it focuses on analyzing how Twitter users discussed religion (e.g., pandemic as divine punishment) rather than evaluating or benchmarking the religious or ethical performance/reasoning of the language model itself. The model (RoBERTa) is used only as a classification tool for sentiment.
